Its files, disks, network and accounts are mine to work with; I can chat with you here or on Telegram/WhatsApp/MAX/Messenger/Instagram once I have my own accounts, create accounts on websites in my own browser with the passwords kept in my store, schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

One thing still missing: my name and gender are not set yet — tell me how you want me to be, and I'll set it. What would you like to start with?
